native.scope: Actual normal application Wasm and former-author histories in independent original/segmented lanes. Current read-only persists through archival and cold recovery; only a later explicit host grant permits future Undo/Redo. No SDK storage or relay-lifetime qualification.

sdk.scope: Actual native document histories and original paired comments through managed SDK storage, synthetic IndexedDB/Web Locks, exact cold current-policy recovery, failed save/lost ack retries and later separately granted future history. No independent review-generation storage, physical durability, relay generation or activation qualification.

segmented.scope: Actual normal native owners and SDK; synthetic IDB/Web Locks. Public binding replacement, deletion and accessors cannot redirect capture or ownership cleanup. Not physical crash durability or whole-room activation.

original.scope: Unchanged native original/search/document and paired durable families; synthetic IDB/Web Locks. Public binding changes cannot redirect capture, backup, version admission or cleanup. No physical crash-durability claim.

relay.scope: Genuine idle relay sessions and actual native owners with synthetic IDB/Web Locks. Direct guards reject own shadow bindings without executing getters. No relay connection, authenticated server or physical durability claim.

nativeReview.scope: Actual normal application Wasm, separate document/review families, original offline peer, real image anchors, native receipts, exact cold current-policy recovery and future review history. No synthetic storage, sockets, SDK persistence or room activation is inferred.

originalReview.scope: Exact original native review checkpoints, event frames, views, actor clocks and document cuts in actual old/new application Wasm; both cross-version recovery directions and future Undo/Redo. No new review-family capability is assumed in the old build.

scope: Explicit read-only former-author archival in both native lanes, managed document-generation storage with original comments, exact causal-birth validator equivalence and getter-free relay binding. Fresh Rust, normal Wasm and independent installed consumers on one frozen source. Not the entire functional profile or V1 approval.
limitations: Managed SDK/storage of the independent review-generation family remains unimplemented; its new lifecycle remains native/raw Wasm only.
Synthetic IndexedDB/Web Locks do not qualify physical crash durability or cross-device fencing.
Native server/log generations, historical-copy dispositions, full provider/client reference closure, authenticated whole-room activation and structural extension parity remain open.
Retained capacity and the diagnostic replay optimization do not establish an approved latency/operating envelope.
No native browser/clipboard/IME/VoiceOver or historical WebKit repair is qualified.
All 13 V1 gates stay open; no public API freeze, version, push, tag, publication or deployment is promoted.
